# truefoundry_mcp_server (Resource)

Manages a remote MCP server registered on the TrueFoundry AI Gateway, proxied at {gateway}/{tenant}/mcp/{name}/server. Applied as an `mcp-server/remote` manifest via `PUT /api/svc/v1/apply`. For OpenAPI-based MCP servers use `truefoundry_openapi_mcp_server`; TrueFoundry-managed and stdio servers are not supported. Existing servers can be imported by their FQN, e.g. `terraform import truefoundry_mcp_server.example my-tenant:mcp-server:my-server`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A remote MCP server proxied by the AI Gateway, authenticating with a
# static header stored as a TrueFoundry secret reference.
resource "truefoundry_mcp_server" "deepwiki" {
  name        = "deepwiki"
  description = "AI-powered documentation for GitHub repositories"
  url         = "https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp"

  auth = {
    type       = "header"
    auth_level = "global"
    headers = {
      "Authorization" = "my-tenant:hashicorp:vault-secrets:secret-store:vault::mcp/deepwiki/token"
    }
  }

  tool_settings = [
    {
      name        = "ask_question"
      description = "Ask any question about a GitHub repository"
      annotations = {
        read_only_hint = true
      }
    },
  ]

  collaborators = [
    {
      subject = "team:everyone"
      role_id = "mcp-server-user"
    },
  ]
}

# A remote MCP server behind an OAuth2 (OIDC) identity provider; each
# gateway user authorizes individually via the authorization_code flow.
resource "truefoundry_mcp_server" "internal_api" {
  name        = "internal-api"
  description = "Internal API tools"
  url         = "https://internal.example.com/mcp"

  auth = {
    type              = "oauth2"
    grant_type        = "authorization_code"
    provider          = "custom"
    jwt_source        = "id_token"
    authorization_url = "https://idp.example.com/auth"
    token_url         = "https://idp.example.com/token"
    client_id         = "my-tenant:hashicorp:vault-secrets:secret-store:vault::idp/client_id"
    client_secret     = "my-tenant:hashicorp:vault-secrets:secret-store:vault::idp/client_secret"
    scopes            = ["openid", "email", "profile"]

    code_challenge_methods_supported = ["S256"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Human-readable description shown to gateway users and AI agents.
- `name` (String) Name of the MCP server (3-73 characters, lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens). Changing it replaces the server.
- `url` (String) URL of the MCP server endpoint, e.g. https://mcp.example.com/mcp.

### Optional

- `additional_headers` (Map of String) Non-secret custom headers sent to the MCP server with every request.
- `auth` (Attributes) How the gateway authenticates against the MCP server. Omitted means no authentication. `type` selects the mode; the other fields belong to one mode each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth))
- `collaborators` (Attributes Set) Subjects with a role on this MCP server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collaborators))
- `tags` (Map of String) Free-form key-value tags on the MCP server.
- `tls` (Attributes) TLS verification settings for the connection to the MCP server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tls))
- `tool_settings` (Attributes List) Per-tool overrides for the tools the MCP server exposes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tool_settings))

### Read-Only

- `fqn` (String) Fully qualified name of the MCP server, e.g. my-tenant:mcp-server:my-server.
- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the MCP server.

<a id="nestedatt--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth`

Required:

- `type` (String) Authentication mode: `header` (static headers), `oauth2`, or `passthrough` (forward the caller's Authorization header).

Optional:

- `additional_token_params` (Map of String) Extra parameters sent with the token request (type `oauth2`).
- `auth_level` (String) Whether the headers apply for all users (`global`) or each user supplies their own (`per_user`) (type `header`).
- `authorization_url` (String) OAuth2 authorization endpoint (type `oauth2`, authorization_code grant).
- `client_id` (String) OAuth2 client ID; accepts a TrueFoundry secret reference (type `oauth2`).
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth2 client secret. A TrueFoundry secret reference is recommended; the control plane returns it as stored, so drift is detected (type `oauth2`).
- `code_challenge_methods_supported` (Set of String) PKCE code challenge methods the authorization server supports; only `S256` is allowed (type `oauth2`).
- `grant_type` (String) OAuth2 grant: `authorization_code` or `client_credentials` (type `oauth2`).
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Headers sent to the MCP server, e.g. {"Authorization" = "Bearer ..."} (type `header`). Values accept TrueFoundry secret references (recommended); the control plane returns them as stored, so drift is detected.
- `introspection_url` (String) OAuth2 token introspection endpoint (type `oauth2`).
- `jwt_source` (String) Which token the gateway forwards: `access_token` or `id_token` (type `oauth2`).
- `provider` (String) OAuth2 provider: `custom`, `auth0`, or `okta` (type `oauth2`).
- `registration_url` (String) OAuth2 dynamic client registration endpoint (type `oauth2`).
- `scopes` (Set of String) OAuth2 scopes to request (type `oauth2`).
- `token_url` (String) OAuth2 token endpoint (type `oauth2`).


<a id="nestedatt--collaborators"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collaborators`

Required:

- `role_id` (String) Role to assign, e.g. mcp-server-user or mcp-server-manager.
- `subject` (String) Subject FQN, e.g. user:jane@example.com or team:everyone.


<a id="nestedatt--tls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tls`

Required:

- `reject_unauthorized` (Boolean) Reject connections not authorized by the configured CAs.

Optional:

- `ca_cert` (String) Custom CA certificate(s) used for TLS verification.


<a id="nestedatt--tool_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tool_settings`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the tool as exposed by the MCP server.

Optional:

- `annotations` (Attributes) Behavior hints for this tool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tool_settings--annotations))
- `description` (String) Replacement description shown to AI agents instead of the tool's own.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Hide this tool from gateway users.

<a id="nestedatt--tool_settings--annotations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tool_settings.annotations`

Optional:

- `destructive_hint` (Boolean) The tool may perform destructive updates.
- `read_only_hint` (Boolean) The tool does not modify its environment.
